# Veadicastro

> India's leading AI-powered Vedic astrology platform combining ancient Vedic wisdom with modern artificial intelligence.

Veadicastro provides personalized astrological guidance, predictions, and insights through Vedika AI — a proprietary AI trained on authentic Vedic astrology principles. Core features include free AI astrology chat, Kundli generation, and a personalized dashboard. Supports English and Hindi, with NASA-grade planetary calculations via Swiss Ephemeris.

## Core Services

- [Free AI Astrology Chat](https://veadicastro.in/free-ai-astrology-chat): Chat with Vedika AI for instant Vedic astrology answers, birth chart analysis, dosha checking, and remedy suggestions. Free, no registration required.
- [Free Kundli Generator](https://veadicastro.in/free-kundli-generator): Generate detailed Janam Kundli (birth charts) with planetary positions, Dasha analysis, house predictions, and yogas. Free and instant.
- [Personalized Dashboard](https://veadicastro.in/dashboard): Daily predictions, life guidance, future forecasts, and chat history. Free account required.
